title: Wagara
description: Fifty-eight classical Japanese patterns that tile, drawn on canvas from their constructions — waves and hemp stars, tortoiseshell and fretwork, thunder spirals and linked chains, diamond lattices and stone walls, mist, rain and willow. Patterns only: continuous fields, no pictures and no image files. Every pattern recolors with its tone.
usage: Patterns are drawn, not tiled from images — each has a period and a logic. Search the picker by name or motif; the caption under the canvas tells each pattern's story.
a11y: Pattern is texture: the canvas is aria-hidden and any text over it must pass contrast on the flat tone color alone, pattern removed. Under prefers-reduced-motion nothing changes — patterns were always still.
